name: editor
title: Rich text editor
description: A rich text editor with a toolbar you write as markup. It submits HTML or Markdown through a hidden input.

classes.name: editor
classes.description: The editor frame: a bordered box like an input, holding the toolbar and the content.

classes.name: editor__toolbar
classes.description: Row of formatting buttons above the content. Give it role="toolbar" and an aria-label.

classes.name: editor__group
classes.description: A set of related toolbar buttons, separated from the next set by a line.

classes.name: editor__content
classes.description: Where the editable document goes. Also styles saved rich text: headings, lists, quotes, code and links.

variables.name: --editor-max-height
variables.description: Height after which the content scrolls.

attributes.name: data-editor
attributes.description: Turns the container into an editor.

attributes.name: data-editor-target="content"
attributes.description: The element Tiptap renders the document into.

attributes.name: data-editor-target="input"
attributes.description: Holds the document: its value is the initial content and it is updated on every change, so the form submits it.

attributes.name: data-editor-format
attributes.description: "html" (default) or "markdown". Markdown reads and writes the input as Markdown and needs @tiptap/markdown.

attributes.name: data-editor-placeholder
attributes.description: Text shown while the editor is empty.

attributes.name: data-editor-editable
attributes.description: Set to "false" to show the content read-only.

attributes.name: data-editor-level-param
attributes.description: Heading level (1–6) for the heading action. Defaults to 2.

actions.name: link
actions.description: Asks for a URL and links the selection. An empty URL removes the link.

actions.name: heading
actions.description: Toggles a heading of the level in data-editor-level-param.

events.name: velle:editor:ready
events.description: The editor was created. event.detail.editor is the Tiptap Editor, for adding your own commands.

events.name: velle:editor:change
events.description: The document changed. event.detail has editor and value (the HTML or Markdown).

notes: Toolbar buttons get aria-pressed when their format applies to the selection, and are disabled when their action cannot run there. Use any subset of buttons, in any order.
@tiptap/markdown is loaded only when data-editor-format="markdown" is used, so an HTML-only page can leave it out of the import map.
Keep every @tiptap package on the same version. Mixing versions loads two copies of ProseMirror and breaks the editor.

The import map uses esm.sh, as Tiptap's docs do, because it shares one copy of each ProseMirror package. jsDelivr's +esm builds load several copies and the editor fails with "Adding different instances of a keyed plugin".
The hidden input also fires an input event on every change, so autosave and other form behaviors see edits.
Sanitize submitted HTML on the server before showing it to other people.
